records.pageTitle: UCP205 - FYH Cast Iron Pillow Block - 25mm Inside Diameter

listingIdentity.description: The UCP205 FYH Cast Iron Pillow Block is the ideal solution for your bearing and housing assembly needs. This sturdy Pillow Block comes equipped with a fully sealed Bearing Insert already fitted within the housing, ensuring optimal performance and durability. Crafted from high-quality cast iron, this Pillow Block boasts exceptional strength and reliability, making it suitable for a wide range of applications. This two-bolt unit has hexagon socket set screws and a 25mm shaft diameter.Key FeaturesReplaceable InsertsThe Bearing Insert in the UCP205 can be easily removed from the P205 housing, allowing for future replacements as needed.Self-Aligning AbilityThe convex shape of the Bearing Inserts outer ring along with the concave sphered shape inside the housing gives this UCP205 Pillow Block Unit the ability to self-align, adjust for shaft deviation, and reduce abnormal load.Set Screw FixingEquipped with two hexagon socket set screws, the Bearing Insert securely tightens against the shaft once fitted, ensuring stability, and reducing the risk of slippage or misalignment.Re-lubrication CapabilityThe UCP205 allows for effortless re-lubrication via the grease hole and a grease fitting, promoting smooth operation and prolonging the lifespan of the bearing assembly.Versatile Industry ApplicationsThese Pillow Block Bearing Units are relied upon in many industries, including mining, agriculture, manufacturing and production, and industrial engineering.
